say:4:1533004004:0.text: By all that is holy, get it away! Abort mission! Flee!

say:5:1533004005:0.text: The note holds but a single word of text. It's barely recognizable... It's a name...
say:5:1533004005:0.source_cn: 字条上只有一行字。你依稀辨认出，那应该是谁人的名字……
